title: Gabriela Morales
summary: Co-founder and managing director (CEO in some coverage) of Ignite20 Ventures, a $7M CPG fund and hybrid accelerator launched February 2025 that invests $50,000 in each of about 20 early-stage food, beverage, health, beauty and pet brands a year (60 over three years), ending in a Bentonville demo day; discussed on Taste Radio Ep. 716 (April 2025).
why_relevant: Writes pre-seed-sized $50K checks into early food and beverage brands with retail-buyer access, a direct fit for Sooz's first raise.

details.role: Co-founder & Managing Director (CEO in some coverage)
details.contact_path: Apply to an Ignite20 Ventures cohort; Taste Radio Ep. 716 (April 2025)

title: Kyle Fitzpatrick
summary: Founder of Paperboy Ventures, a CPG investor-media platform whose Fund I (target up to $3M, covered by BevNET in Nov 2025) planned to deploy during 2026 into seed-to-Series A food and beverage brands with up to $10M net revenue; Paperboy showcases have featured brands such as Sauz, The Coconut Cult and Parch. He was a semifinal judge at BevNET's New Beverage Showdown in June 2026.
why_relevant: Small-fund early-stage CPG investor who judges beverage pitch events and showcases brands to a wide investor audience.

details.contact_path: Paperboy Ventures newsletter/podcast and brand showcase cohorts; BevNET New Beverage Showdown (semifinal judge, June 2026)

title: Nate Cooper
summary: Barrel Ventures investor featured on Startup CPG's Investor Spotlight; says Olipop was his very first check, and describes Barrel as investing pre-seed to Series A in anything touching food, from pre-farm to post-fork. Episode date and recent deals were not confirmed.
why_relevant: Pre-seed-capable food investor with a breakout beverage win (Olipop) and a public Startup CPG profile.

details.contact_path: Startup CPG community (Investor Spotlight episode); Barrel Ventures

title: Alex Malamatinas
summary: Founder and managing partner of New York's Melitas Ventures (better-for-you food and beverage; seed and Series A, typically $500K-$3M per investor profiles); listed boards include Lemon Perfect, Verb Energy and MUD WTR, and aggregators show a Final Boss Sour seed deal (May 2025). Featured on Startup CPG Ep. 155, 'The Beverage Investors'.
why_relevant: Beverage-savvy lead investor, but check sizes make him a next-round target rather than a pre-seed angel.

details.contact_path: Startup CPG community (Ep. 155 'The Beverage Investors'); Melitas Ventures

title: Madeline Haydon
summary: Founder of nutpods (dairy-free creamer launched in 2015, backed by CircleUp Growth Partners and VMG Partners, later acquired by MPearlRock); a semifinal judge at BevNET's New Beverage Showdown during BevNET Live NYC (June 2026). No personal angel investments were found.
why_relevant: Exited beverage-adjacent founder who judges early-stage beverage pitches; a Showdown entry puts Sooz in front of her.

details.contact_path: BevNET New Beverage Showdown (apply via BevNET Live); nutpods
